description: SYNTACTIC-CONSTRUCTION RelationCue (graph data) extending the relation-vocabulary lexicon so the self-build composer can GROUND a SYNTACTIC concern (a function word FRAMES / PRECEDES a content word = the 'the X' construction) to a structural relation whose label routes ground_concern to _compose_construction_rule. Added as its OWN seed (not by editing relation_vocabulary.json) because _load_relation_cues reads ALL RelationCue nodes; a new cue = new data. The agent, given a framed concern that leads each clause with one of these keywords, grounds it via THIS cue (held RelationCue perception, donkey=0) and AUTHORS the graph-native construction rule.
